segments.text: Hello Marcus, this is Sarah from Openline. How can I help?
Hi Sarah, we need 253m32 controllers for the new board.
The production runs starts in three weeks, so delivery is critical.
Understood, I will check the supplier and send you a mate by Thursday.
Good, price is less important this time, but please do not be late again.
I will also look for an alternate part in case talk is short.
Perfect. You can reach me on my mobile 066001234.
